description: Upload a file (Word, PDF, PowerPoint, Excel — also the old .doc, .ppt and .xls —, TXT, Markdown, or a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP picture; up to 20 MB) to review or edit it, or to use it as a source. Returns its file_id. Give `path` for a file on this computer.

content_base64.description: The file's bytes in base64 (for small files).

filename.description: Its name with extension, e.g. contract.docx. Needed with content_base64.

path.description: Absolute path of the file on this computer.

url.description: A public URL to download the file from.

name: upload_file
title: Upload file
